<!-- About Me Section -->

<span style="font-size: 18px;"><b>About Me</b></span>

<div class="aboutme-text">

I joined Children's Mercy Kansas City as a Post Doctoral Research Scholar in the Fridley Lab in August 2024. I received a B.A. in Mathematics from Bloomsburg University in 2018, an M.S. in Applied Statistics in 2020, and a Ph.D. in Computational Mathematical and Statistical Sciences from Marquette University in 2024. My dissertation research focused on Bayesian methods for functional MRI image reconstruction. My current research develops statistical methods for spatial proteomic and spatial omics data, with the goal of characterizing the tumor microenvironment and identifying spatial patterns associated with patient outcomes.

</div>
